title: A pharmacy chain in Vermont implemented AI for efficiency. It’s led to delays, incorrect information and privacy concerns.
excerpt: As AI pops up in healthcare systems across the country, several lawyers told VTDigger that the technology is outpacing regulation, leaving consumers vulnerable.
content_html:
In voicemails, spam folders and text messages across Vermont, an artificial intelligence tool is filing through years of pharmaceutical records, incoherently listing drugs and requesting the wrong refills on sensitive medication. 

And customers often have no idea they agreed to it.

“He calls you all the time, and he doesn’t say what the drug is,” said Kathy Callaghan, a Vermont customer of Kinney Drugs, referring to a new AI tool recently put to use by the Vermont and New York pharmacy chain. 

Nearly every day, she recalled, her phone rings, and she hears an incomprehensive mutter of a drug from the AI voice. Confused, she approves the refill order, thinking the request is legitimate and she really is out of a prescription. 

So far, it hasn’t been, she said. 

“I’ve got four bottles of something that I take twice a week sitting here,” Callaghan said. 

Earlier this summer, amid a nationwide wave of AI technology entering healthcare systems, Kinney Drugs implemented a new AI assistant for prescription refill services, lauding the tool as a way to improve communication and efficiency. But customers say it’s doing the opposite.  

According to nearly a dozen Kinney Drugs customers across its stores in Vermont and New York who spoke to VTDigger, the AI rollout has coincided with a range of problems. Delays have grown between physicians ordering drugs and the pharmacy processing them. The system has been unable to locate longtime customer accounts, has ordered incorrect dosages and has failed to notify customers when refills were ready for pickup. And these inaccuracies are raising privacy concerns amongst customers. 

Their mounting frustrations toward the AI is leading some customers to leave the pharmacy entirely, they said, and forcing others to continue using a system they distrust due to a lack of pharmaceutical options in rural areas. 

As AI pops up in healthcare systems across the country, several lawyers told VTDigger that the technology is outpacing regulation, leaving consumer protections thin. 

“There’s a delay in laws that are coming onto the books, so we’ve not seen a detailed picture of how companies are going to comply or how states are going to enforce the laws,” said Cody Venzke, a senior staff attorney at the ACLU.

In Vermont, a new data privacy bill, S.71, signed by Gov. Phil Scott on June 16, takes effect in two years. That delay creates a gap in compliance to a bill that privacy advocates say is already too weak to protect consumers.    

“Even if it were in effect, I’m not sure that it would necessarily cover the situation,” said Ryan Kriger, a Vermont lawyer and resident who testified on the bill.

‘No value, no benefit’ 

Kinney Drugs implemented the AI virtual assistant for patient communication and refill services in May. Soon after, its customers began to experience problems, they said.   

“My first impression was it was just more complicated and cumbersome than the previous recording and service,” said Matt Penney, who’s been receiving medication at a Kinney Drugs in Vermont for around two years. 

Previously, to refill a prescription at Kinney Drugs, a customer would call a prompt-based, touch-tone, phone system that would give them the opportunity to navigate a keypad to reach a pharmacist. Customers who spoke to VTDigger said this old system worked smoothly, and they had no problems. 

Not so much with the new system, they said.

“It’s just something that wastes time and delays customer service. As far as I’m concerned, it has absolutely no value, no benefit to the customer,” Vermont Kinney Drugs customer Dave Bellini said. 

The AI assistant, which Kinney Drugs named Burt, after its founder, was built by third-party AI pharmaceutical company, Synerio. In the pharmacy’s terms, Kinney Drugs states that “Burt may not be accurate, complete or up-to-date and may be misleading or contain errors and omissions.”

Any customer who provides their telephone number to Kinney Drugs automatically consents to interacting with the tool, though they may later opt out, according to the pharmacy’s terms. While some customers recalled signing onto a new refill system earlier this summer, others said they didn’t realize the company implemented the new tool until they called for a refill and heard the AI voice.   

“Burt demands that you talk to him,” said Maria Aveni, a Vermont Kinney Drugs customer who has worked in healthcare as an anesthesiologist. “There’s no option to use a keypad to enter what you want to, which has been the case with other telephone interactions I’ve had. So it’s more of a talk to Burt or don’t get your drugs.” 

According to Aveni and other customers who spoke to VTDigger, Kinney Drugs did not communicate about the tool before implementation. 

When this month Aveni experienced a delay in receiving medication that her physician had ordered, she felt grateful it was not a lifesaving drug. Nevertheless, she was alarmed. Since then, she said she only goes in person to her pharmacy for refills in order to avoid AI interactions. 

But for others, who live in rural areas and have limited access to transportation, going in person to receive refills as a way around the AI is impossible. 

A Kinney Drugs representative who did not want to be identified by name, wrote in a statement to VTDigger that the company is “aware that some patients have experienced frustration with Burt, especially during rollout,” and that it is reviewing each concern and attempting to reach each patient. 

While customers said they were confused over why Kinney Drugs switched to the AI, the company cited a clear reason: to eliminate repetitive tasks and free up time for its pharmacists.

Its leaders believe the AI has helped in achieving this goal, with one director saying that “it’s definitely doing the trick and handling those phone calls in such a nice manner that it’s reducing the calls to our pharmacy.”  

But customers’ experience with the tool has led to an oftentimes opposite effect. As they encounter problems with the AI, many are turning to pharmacists more for help. In Vermont, pharmacists are already overburdened due to a chronic worker shortage.  

“It’s slowing down productivity of an already stressed staff, and because that staff has treated me for a long time, and I feel loyalty, it isn’t just a financial concern for me, it’s an inhumane way to treat the staff,” Aveni said.

‘Privacy is just about out the window’ 

While the AI tool’s reported inaccuracies are the primary frustration for many customers, others are citing privacy concerns for leaving the chain.   

“Once I went into the store and actually read the privacy policy, I was shocked, and immediately transferred my prescriptions to UVM Hospital,” Tuan Green, a former Vermont Kinney Drugs customer, said. 

The pharmacy’s privacy policy, released the same month as the AI assistant, discloses, for example, that customers’ protected health information may be used in AI tools to improve the pharmacy’s operations.  

“These days, privacy is just about out the window,” Stephen McArthur, a Vermont Kinney Drugs customer, said.

Beyond Kinney Drugs, customers and privacy experts have also raised concerns with Synerio, the Texas-based technology company that supplies the AI tool to the pharmacy.  

Joseph Near, an associate professor of computer science at the University of Vermont, said that, privacy-wise, the AI tool is worse than the pharmacy’s previous refill system because this additional company, Synerio, now also has access to customers’ health data. 

“If I just interact with my healthcare provider, I’m relying on the security that they have. If they now start interacting with many other organizations, I now have to start worrying about all the security issues with each of them,” Bradley Malin, a professor of biomedical informatics at Vanderbilt University Medical Center, said, referring to Synerio. 

The Kinney Drugs representative said that the company maintains “multiple layers of security controls,” invests in “information security technologies to help protect sensitive data” and has the protocols in place to respond to potential data breaches. 

AI in healthcare settings also raises a host of concerns surrounding the federal health privacy law HIPAA, several lawyers and data privacy experts said, pointing to possible data sharing of protected health information. 

However, as long as the pharmacy has a business associate agreement — the contract under HIPAA that establishes that third-party vendors securely handle protected health information — the companies are contractually obliged to handle data securely. The Kinney Drugs representative declined to share the agreement, citing an inability to disclose private vendor contracts, but wrote that the company “maintains the appropriate agreements.”

Synerio did not respond to multiple requests for comment, but also says on its webpages that the tools it creates are built to be compliant with HIPAA. 

While Synerio did not respond to VTDigger’s questions about customer protections, Kinney Drugs’ pharmacy management system, McKesson, acknowledged them in public filings, writing that “reliance on third-party AI tools and solutions may expose us to risks that are outside of our control, including compliance gaps.”

‘Consent is not a realistic solution’ 

As states move to create laws aimed at protecting data privacy, burgeoning AI tools, like the one Kinney Drug’s implemented, could serve as a test case for how effective these laws are. 

Zach Tomanelli, a privacy advocate with the Vermont Public Interest Research Group, said that customers’ experience with AI is an example of why the Vermont data privacy bill should have gone further. The law gives residents the right to know what information is being collected about them, correct inaccurate data and opt out of their data being sold. But lawyers and advocates say it includes too many exemptions for companies collecting data. 

Near, the UVM computer science professor, said that regulations like the new Vermont law are inherently flawed simply because they are based on consumer consent. Kinney Drugs, for instance, spreads its terms and conditions across 11 documents. 

“I think that people absolutely do not understand what they’re consenting to, and so basing our regulation and what we think is okay on the idea of consent is not a realistic solution to these kinds of privacy concerns nowadays,” he said. 

Stacey Tovino, a University of Oklahoma professor who teaches HIPAA, said the privacy law lets patients petition to correct inaccurate health information. But the process is so cumbersome that Tovino herself said she would just switch pharmacies to avoid the exposure. 

Customers in rural areas of Vermont, however, may not have an accessible option to switch to, and even those who do say they don’t want to, citing the personal connection they’ve built with the small-scale pharmacy chain and the people who work there. 

“I don’t want to leave the pharmacy that I can walk to, that I really like,” Aveni said. “But I will if it doesn’t sort itself out.”

Disclosure: Kinney Drugs is an advertiser with VTDigger.

sentences.zh: “我的第一印象是，它比以前的录音和服务更复杂、更麻烦，”马特·彭尼 (Matt Penney) 说，他在佛蒙特州的金尼药房 (Kinney Drugs) 接受药物治疗已有两年左右。

blocks.html_en: Previously, to refill a prescription at Kinney Drugs, a customer would call a prompt-based, touch-tone, phone system that would give them the opportunity to navigate a keypad to reach a pharmacist. Customers who spoke to VTDigger said this old system worked smoothly, and they had no problems.

sentences.en: Previously, to refill a prescription at Kinney Drugs, a customer would call a prompt-based, touch-tone, phone system that would give them the opportunity to navigate a keypad to reach a pharmacist.
sentences.zh: 以前，要在 Kinney Drugs 重新配药，顾客需要拨打基于提示的按键式电话系统，这样他们就可以通过键盘联系药剂师。

sentences.en: Customers who spoke to VTDigger said this old system worked smoothly, and they had no problems.
sentences.zh: 与 VTDigger 交谈的客户表示，这个旧系统运行顺利，没有出现任何问题。

blocks.html_en: Not so much with the new system, they said.

sentences.en: Not so much with the new system, they said.
sentences.zh: 他们说，新系统的情况就不一样了。

blocks.html_en: “It’s just something that wastes time and delays customer service. As far as I’m concerned, it has absolutely no value, no benefit to the customer,” Vermont Kinney Drugs customer Dave Bellini said.

sentences.en: “It’s just something that wastes time and delays customer service.
sentences.zh: “这只是浪费时间并延迟客户服务的事情。

sentences.en: As far as I’m concerned, it has absolutely no value, no benefit to the customer,” Vermont Kinney Drugs customer Dave Bellini said.
sentences.zh: 就我而言，它绝对没有价值，对客户没有任何好处，”Vermont Kinney Drugs 客户 Dave Bellini 说。

blocks.html_en: The AI assistant, which Kinney Drugs named Burt, after its founder, was built by third-party AI pharmaceutical company, Synerio. In the pharmacy’s terms, Kinney Drugs states that “Burt may not be accurate, complete or up-to-date and may be misleading or contain errors and omissions.”

sentences.en: The AI assistant, which Kinney Drugs named Burt, after its founder, was built by third-party AI pharmaceutical company, Synerio.
sentences.zh: 该人工智能助手由第三方人工智能制药公司 Synerio 打造，Kinney Drugs 以创始人的名字命名为 Burt。

sentences.en: In the pharmacy’s terms, Kinney Drugs states that “Burt may not be accurate, complete or up-to-date and may be misleading or contain errors and omissions.”
sentences.zh: 在药房条款中，Kinney Drugs 指出“Burt 可能不准确、不完整或不最新，并且可能具有误导性或包含错误和遗漏。”

blocks.html_en: Any customer who provides their telephone number to Kinney Drugs automatically consents to interacting with the tool, though they may later opt out, according to the pharmacy’s terms. While some customers recalled signing onto a new refill system earlier this summer, others said they didn’t realize the company implemented the new tool until they called for a refill and heard the AI voice.

sentences.en: Any customer who provides their telephone number to Kinney Drugs automatically consents to interacting with the tool, though they may later opt out, according to the pharmacy’s terms.
sentences.zh: 任何向 Kinney Drugs 提供电话号码的顾客都会自动同意与该工具进行交互，尽管根据药房的条款，他们稍后可能会选择退出。

sentences.en: While some customers recalled signing onto a new refill system earlier this summer, others said they didn’t realize the company implemented the new tool until they called for a refill and heard the AI voice.
sentences.zh: 虽然一些客户回忆起今年夏天早些时候签署了新的补充系统，但其他人表示，直到他们要求补充并听到人工智能声音时，他们才意识到该公司实施了新工具。

blocks.html_en: “Burt demands that you talk to him,” said Maria Aveni, a Vermont Kinney Drugs customer who has worked in healthcare as an anesthesiologist. “There’s no option to use a keypad to enter what you want to, which has been the case with other telephone interactions I’ve had. So it’s more of a talk to Burt or don’t get your drugs.”

sentences.en: “Burt demands that you talk to him,” said Maria Aveni, a Vermont Kinney Drugs customer who has worked in healthcare as an anesthesiologist.
sentences.zh: “伯特要求你和他谈谈，”佛蒙特州金尼药业 (Vermont Kinney Drugs) 客户、曾在医疗保健领域担任麻醉师的玛丽亚·阿文尼 (Maria Aveni) 说。

sentences.en: “There’s no option to use a keypad to enter what you want to, which has been the case with other telephone interactions I’ve had.
sentences.zh: “没有选择使用键盘来输入你想要的内容，这就是我进行过的其他电话交互的情况。

sentences.en: So it’s more of a talk to Burt or don’t get your drugs.”
sentences.zh: 所以这更像是和伯特谈谈，否则就别去拿药。”

blocks.html_en: According to Aveni and other customers who spoke to VTDigger, Kinney Drugs did not communicate about the tool before implementation.

sentences.en: According to Aveni and other customers who spoke to VTDigger, Kinney Drugs did not communicate about the tool before implementation.
sentences.zh: 据 Aveni 和其他接受 VTDigger 采访的客户称，Kinney Drugs 在实施之前并未就该工具进行沟通。

blocks.html_en: When this month Aveni experienced a delay in receiving medication that her physician had ordered, she felt grateful it was not a lifesaving drug. Nevertheless, she was alarmed. Since then, she said she only goes in person to her pharmacy for refills in order to avoid AI interactions.

sentences.en: When this month Aveni experienced a delay in receiving medication that her physician had ordered, she felt grateful it was not a lifesaving drug.
sentences.zh: 本月，当艾维尼（Aveni）延迟收到医生开出的药物时，她感到很庆幸这不是救命药。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, she was alarmed.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，她还是感到惊慌。

sentences.en: Since then, she said she only goes in person to her pharmacy for refills in order to avoid AI interactions.
sentences.zh: 她说，从那以后，她只亲自去药房配药，以避免人工智能互动。

blocks.html_en: But for others, who live in rural areas and have limited access to transportation, going in person to receive refills as a way around the AI is impossible.

sentences.en: But for others, who live in rural areas and have limited access to transportation, going in person to receive refills as a way around the AI is impossible.
sentences.zh: 但对于生活在农村地区、交通条件有限的其他人来说，亲自去领取补充品来绕过人工智能是不可能的。

blocks.html_en: A Kinney Drugs representative who did not want to be identified by name, wrote in a statement to VTDigger that the company is “aware that some patients have experienced frustration with Burt, especially during rollout,” and that it is reviewing each concern and attempting to reach each patient.

sentences.en: A Kinney Drugs representative who did not want to be identified by name, wrote in a statement to VTDigger that the company is “aware that some patients have experienced frustration with Burt, especially during rollout,” and that it is reviewing each concern and attempting to reach each patient.
sentences.zh: 一位不愿透露姓名的 Kinney Drugs 代表在给 VTDigger 的一份声明中写道，该公司“意识到一些患者对 Burt 感到沮丧，特别是在推出期间”，并且正在审查每个问题并试图接触到每个患者。

blocks.html_en: While customers said they were confused over why Kinney Drugs switched to the AI, the company cited a clear reason: to eliminate repetitive tasks and free up time for its pharmacists.

sentences.en: While customers said they were confused over why Kinney Drugs switched to the AI, the company cited a clear reason: to eliminate repetitive tasks and free up time for its pharmacists.
sentences.zh: 虽然客户表示他们对 Kinney Drugs 为何转向人工智能感到困惑，但该公司给出了一个明确的原因：消除重复性任务并为药剂师腾出时间。

blocks.html_en: Its leaders believe the AI has helped in achieving this goal, with one director saying that “it’s definitely doing the trick and handling those phone calls in such a nice manner that it’s reducing the calls to our pharmacy.”

sentences.en: Its leaders believe the AI has helped in achieving this goal, with one director saying that “it’s definitely doing the trick and handling those phone calls in such a nice manner that it’s reducing the calls to our pharmacy.”
sentences.zh: 该公司的领导者相信人工智能有助于实现这一目标，一位董事表示“它确实起到了作用，并且以如此好的方式处理这些电话，从而减少了打给我们药房的电话。”

blocks.html_en: But customers’ experience with the tool has led to an oftentimes opposite effect. As they encounter problems with the AI, many are turning to pharmacists more for help. In Vermont, pharmacists are already overburdened due to a chronic worker shortage.

sentences.en: But customers’ experience with the tool has led to an oftentimes opposite effect.
sentences.zh: 但客户对该工具的体验往往会带来相反的效果。

sentences.en: As they encounter problems with the AI, many are turning to pharmacists more for help.
sentences.zh: 当他们遇到人工智能问题时，许多人更多地向药剂师寻求帮助。

sentences.en: In Vermont, pharmacists are already overburdened due to a chronic worker shortage.
sentences.zh: 在佛蒙特州，由于长期劳动力短缺，药剂师已经不堪重负。

blocks.html_en: “It’s slowing down productivity of an already stressed staff, and because that staff has treated me for a long time, and I feel loyalty, it isn’t just a financial concern for me, it’s an inhumane way to treat the staff,” Aveni said.

sentences.en: “It’s slowing down productivity of an already stressed staff, and because that staff has treated me for a long time, and I feel loyalty, it isn’t just a financial concern for me, it’s an inhumane way to treat the staff,” Aveni said.
sentences.zh: “这降低了本已压力重重的员工的生产力，而且由于该员工长期以来一直对待我，而且我感到忠诚，这对我来说不仅仅是一个财务问题，而且是一种不人道的对待员工的方式，”艾维尼说。

blocks.html_en: ‘Privacy is just about out the window’

sentences.en: ‘Privacy is just about out the window’
sentences.zh: “隐私即将被抛之脑后”

blocks.html_en: While the AI tool’s reported inaccuracies are the primary frustration for many customers, others are citing privacy concerns for leaving the chain.

sentences.en: While the AI tool’s reported inaccuracies are the primary frustration for many customers, others are citing privacy concerns for leaving the chain.
sentences.zh: 虽然人工智能工具报告的不准确性是许多客户的主要挫败感，但其他人则以隐私问题为由离开了连锁店。

blocks.html_en: “Once I went into the store and actually read the privacy policy, I was shocked, and immediately transferred my prescriptions to UVM Hospital,” Tuan Green, a former Vermont Kinney Drugs customer, said.

sentences.en: “Once I went into the store and actually read the privacy policy, I was shocked, and immediately transferred my prescriptions to UVM Hospital,” Tuan Green, a former Vermont Kinney Drugs customer, said.
sentences.zh: “当我走进商店并真正阅读隐私政策时，我感到震惊，并立即将我的处方转移到 UVM 医院，”佛蒙特州 Kinney Drugs 前客户 Tuan Green 说。

blocks.html_en: The pharmacy’s privacy policy, released the same month as the AI assistant, discloses, for example, that customers’ protected health information may be used in AI tools to improve the pharmacy’s operations.

sentences.en: The pharmacy’s privacy policy, released the same month as the AI assistant, discloses, for example, that customers’ protected health information may be used in AI tools to improve the pharmacy’s operations.
sentences.zh: 例如，与人工智能助手同月发布的药房隐私政策披露，客户受保护的健康信息可能会在人工智能工具中使用，以改善药房的运营。

blocks.html_en: “These days, privacy is just about out the window,” Stephen McArthur, a Vermont Kinney Drugs customer, said.

sentences.en: “These days, privacy is just about out the window,” Stephen McArthur, a Vermont Kinney Drugs customer, said.
sentences.zh: 佛蒙特金尼药业 (Vermont Kinney Drugs) 的客户史蒂芬·麦克阿瑟 (Stephen McArthur) 表示：“如今，隐私已经被抛之脑后了。”

blocks.html_en: Beyond Kinney Drugs, customers and privacy experts have also raised concerns with Synerio, the Texas-based technology company that supplies the AI tool to the pharmacy.

sentences.en: Beyond Kinney Drugs, customers and privacy experts have also raised concerns with Synerio, the Texas-based technology company that supplies the AI tool to the pharmacy.
sentences.zh: 除了 Kinney Drugs 之外，客户和隐私专家也对 Synerio 表示担忧，Synerio 是一家总部位于德克萨斯州的科技公司，为该药房提供人工智能工具。

blocks.html_en: Joseph Near, an associate professor of computer science at the University of Vermont, said that, privacy-wise, the AI tool is worse than the pharmacy’s previous refill system because this additional company, Synerio, now also has access to customers’ health data.

sentences.en: Joseph Near, an associate professor of computer science at the University of Vermont, said that, privacy-wise, the AI tool is worse than the pharmacy’s previous refill system because this additional company, Synerio, now also has access to customers’ health data.
sentences.zh: 佛蒙特大学计算机科学副教授约瑟夫·尼尔表示，从隐私角度来看，人工智能工具比药房之前的续药系统更糟糕，因为这家名为 Synerio 的新公司现在也可以访问顾客的健康数据。

blocks.html_en: “If I just interact with my healthcare provider, I’m relying on the security that they have. If they now start interacting with many other organizations, I now have to start worrying about all the security issues with each of them,” Bradley Malin, a professor of biomedical informatics at Vanderbilt University Medical Center, said, referring to Synerio.

sentences.en: “If I just interact with my healthcare provider, I’m relying on the security that they have.
sentences.zh: “如果我只是与我的医疗保健提供者互动，我就会依赖他们所提供的安全保障。

sentences.en: If they now start interacting with many other organizations, I now have to start worrying about all the security issues with each of them,” Bradley Malin, a professor of biomedical informatics at Vanderbilt University Medical Center, said, referring to Synerio.
sentences.zh: 如果他们现在开始与许多其他组织进行互动，我现在就必须开始担心他们每个组织的所有安全问题。”范德比尔特大学医学中心生物医学信息学教授 Bradley Malin 在谈到 Synerio 时说道。

blocks.html_en: The Kinney Drugs representative said that the company maintains “multiple layers of security controls,” invests in “information security technologies to help protect sensitive data” and has the protocols in place to respond to potential data breaches.

sentences.en: The Kinney Drugs representative said that the company maintains “multiple layers of security controls,” invests in “information security technologies to help protect sensitive data” and has the protocols in place to respond to potential data breaches.
sentences.zh: Kinney Drugs 代表表示，该公司维持“多层安全控制”，投资“信息安全技术以帮助保护敏感数据”，并制定协议来应对潜在的数据泄露。

blocks.html_en: AI in healthcare settings also raises a host of concerns surrounding the federal health privacy law HIPAA, several lawyers and data privacy experts said, pointing to possible data sharing of protected health information.

sentences.en: AI in healthcare settings also raises a host of concerns surrounding the federal health privacy law HIPAA, several lawyers and data privacy experts said, pointing to possible data sharing of protected health information.
sentences.zh: 几位律师和数据隐私专家表示，医疗保健环境中的人工智能还引起了围绕联邦健康隐私法 HIPAA 的一系列担忧，并指出受保护的健康信息可能存在数据共享。

blocks.html_en: However, as long as the pharmacy has a business associate agreement — the contract under HIPAA that establishes that third-party vendors securely handle protected health information — the companies are contractually obliged to handle data securely. The Kinney Drugs representative declined to share the agreement, citing an inability to disclose private vendor contracts, but wrote that the company “maintains the appropriate agreements.”

sentences.en: However, as long as the pharmacy has a business associate agreement — the contract under HIPAA that establishes that third-party vendors securely handle protected health information — the companies are contractually obliged to handle data securely.
sentences.zh: 然而，只要药房签订了业务合作协议（HIPAA 下的合同，规定第三方供应商安全地处理受保护的健康信息），公司就有合同义务安全地处理数据。

sentences.en: The Kinney Drugs representative declined to share the agreement, citing an inability to disclose private vendor contracts, but wrote that the company “maintains the appropriate agreements.”
sentences.zh: Kinney Drugs 代表拒绝透露该协议，理由是无法披露私人供应商合同，但写道该公司“维持适当的协议”。

blocks.html_en: Synerio did not respond to multiple requests for comment, but also says on its webpages that the tools it creates are built to be compliant with HIPAA.

sentences.en: Synerio did not respond to multiple requests for comment, but also says on its webpages that the tools it creates are built to be compliant with HIPAA.
sentences.zh: Synerio 没有回应多次置评请求，但也在其网页上表示，其创建的工具是为了符合 HIPAA 的要求而构建的。

blocks.html_en: While Synerio did not respond to VTDigger’s questions about customer protections, Kinney Drugs’ pharmacy management system, McKesson, acknowledged them in public filings, writing that “reliance on third-party AI tools and solutions may expose us to risks that are outside of our control, including compliance gaps.”

sentences.en: While Synerio did not respond to VTDigger’s questions about customer protections, Kinney Drugs’ pharmacy management system, McKesson, acknowledged them in public filings, writing that “reliance on third-party AI tools and solutions may expose us to risks that are outside of our control, including compliance gaps.”
sentences.zh: 虽然 Synerio 没有回应 VTDigger 关于客户保护的问题，但 Kinney Drugs 的药房管理系统 McKesson 在公开文件中承认了这些问题，并写道“对第三方人工智能工具和解决方案的依赖可能会让我们面临超出我们控制范围的风险，包括合规漏洞。”

blocks.html_en: ‘Consent is not a realistic solution’

sentences.en: ‘Consent is not a realistic solution’
sentences.zh: “同意并不是一个现实的解决方案”

blocks.html_en: As states move to create laws aimed at protecting data privacy, burgeoning AI tools, like the one Kinney Drug’s implemented, could serve as a test case for how effective these laws are.

sentences.en: As states move to create laws aimed at protecting data privacy, burgeoning AI tools, like the one Kinney Drug’s implemented, could serve as a test case for how effective these laws are.
sentences.zh: 随着各州开始制定旨在保护数据隐私的法律，新兴的人工智能工具（例如 Kinney Drug 实施的工具）可以作为这些法律有效性的测试案例。

blocks.html_en: Zach Tomanelli, a privacy advocate with the Vermont Public Interest Research Group, said that customers’ experience with AI is an example of why the Vermont data privacy bill should have gone further. The law gives residents the right to know what information is being collected about them, correct inaccurate data and opt out of their data being sold. But lawyers and advocates say it includes too many exemptions for companies collecting data.

sentences.en: Zach Tomanelli, a privacy advocate with the Vermont Public Interest Research Group, said that customers’ experience with AI is an example of why the Vermont data privacy bill should have gone further.
sentences.zh: 佛蒙特州公共利益研究小组的隐私倡导者扎克·托马内利 (Zach Tomanelli) 表示，客户对人工智能的体验就是佛蒙特州数据隐私法案应该走得更远的一个例子。

sentences.en: The law gives residents the right to know what information is being collected about them, correct inaccurate data and opt out of their data being sold.
sentences.zh: 该法律赋予居民权利，了解他们的哪些信息正在被收集、纠正不准确的数据以及选择不出售他们的数据。

sentences.en: But lawyers and advocates say it includes too many exemptions for companies collecting data.
sentences.zh: 但律师和倡导者表示，它为收集数据的公司提供了太多的豁免。

blocks.html_en: Near, the UVM computer science professor, said that regulations like the new Vermont law are inherently flawed simply because they are based on consumer consent. Kinney Drugs, for instance, spreads its terms and conditions across 11 documents.

sentences.en: Near, the UVM computer science professor, said that regulations like the new Vermont law are inherently flawed simply because they are based on consumer consent.
sentences.zh: UVM 计算机科学教授尼尔表示，像佛蒙特州新法律这样的法规本质上是有缺陷的，因为它们是基于消费者同意的。

sentences.en: Kinney Drugs, for instance, spreads its terms and conditions across 11 documents.
sentences.zh: 例如，Kinney Drugs 将其条款和条件分散在 11 个文件中。

blocks.html_en: “I think that people absolutely do not understand what they’re consenting to, and so basing our regulation and what we think is okay on the idea of consent is not a realistic solution to these kinds of privacy concerns nowadays,” he said.

sentences.en: “I think that people absolutely do not understand what they’re consenting to, and so basing our regulation and what we think is okay on the idea of consent is not a realistic solution to these kinds of privacy concerns nowadays,” he said.
sentences.zh: 他说：“我认为人们绝对不明白他们同意什么，因此，将我们的监管和我们认为可以接受的内容建立在同意的基础上，并不是解决当今此类隐私问题的现实解决方案。”

blocks.html_en: Stacey Tovino, a University of Oklahoma professor who teaches HIPAA, said the privacy law lets patients petition to correct inaccurate health information. But the process is so cumbersome that Tovino herself said she would just switch pharmacies to avoid the exposure.

sentences.en: Stacey Tovino, a University of Oklahoma professor who teaches HIPAA, said the privacy law lets patients petition to correct inaccurate health information.
sentences.zh: 俄克拉荷马大学 HIPAA 教授史黛西·托维诺 (Stacey Tovino) 表示，隐私法允许患者请求纠正不准确的健康信息。

sentences.en: But the process is so cumbersome that Tovino herself said she would just switch pharmacies to avoid the exposure.
sentences.zh: 但这个过程非常繁琐，托维诺本人表示，她只会换药店以避免接触。

blocks.html_en: Customers in rural areas of Vermont, however, may not have an accessible option to switch to, and even those who do say they don’t want to, citing the personal connection they’ve built with the small-scale pharmacy chain and the people who work there.

sentences.en: Customers in rural areas of Vermont, however, may not have an accessible option to switch to, and even those who do say they don’t want to, citing the personal connection they’ve built with the small-scale pharmacy chain and the people who work there.
sentences.zh: 然而，佛蒙特州农村地区的客户可能没有一个方便的选择可以转用，甚至那些转用的人也说他们不想这样做，理由是他们与小型药房连锁店和那里的工作人员建立了个人联系。

blocks.html_en: “I don’t want to leave the pharmacy that I can walk to, that I really like,” Aveni said. “But I will if it doesn’t sort itself out.”

sentences.en: “I don’t want to leave the pharmacy that I can walk to, that I really like,” Aveni said.
sentences.zh: “我不想离开我真的很喜欢、可以步行去的药房，”艾维尼说。

sentences.en: “But I will if it doesn’t sort itself out.”
sentences.zh: “但如果事情不能自行解决，我会的。”

blocks.html_en: Disclosure: Kinney Drugs is an advertiser with VTDigger.

sentences.en: Disclosure: Kinney Drugs is an advertiser with VTDigger.
sentences.zh: 披露：Kinney Drugs 是 VTDigger 的广告商。

content_html_zh:
在佛蒙特州的语音邮件、垃圾邮件文件夹和短信中，人工智能工具正在归档多年的药品记录，不连贯地列出药物，并要求错误地补充敏感药物。

客户通常不知道他们同意了。

Kinney Drugs 的佛蒙特州客户凯西·卡拉汉 (Kathy Callaghan) 表示：“他总是给你打电话，但不会说这是什么药。”她指的是佛蒙特州和纽约连锁药店最近使用的一种新的人工智能工具。

她回忆说，几乎每天，她的手机都会响起，她会听到人工智能声音中含糊不清地嘀咕着药物的声音。 她很困惑，批准了补充订单，认为这个请求是合法的，而且她的处方确实用完了。

她说，到目前为止还没有。

“我在这里放了四瓶东西，每周吃两次，”卡拉汉说。

今年夏天早些时候，在全国范围内人工智能技术进入医疗保健系统的浪潮中，Kinney Drugs 为处方补充服务实施了新的人工智能助手，并称赞该工具是改善沟通和效率的一种方式。 但顾客表示，这样做适得其反。

据接受 VTDigger 采访的 Kinney Drugs 佛蒙特州和纽约商店的近十几位客户称，人工智能的推出恰逢一系列问题。 医生订购药物和药房处理药物之间的延误越来越多。 该系统无法找到长期客户账户，订购的剂量不正确，并且未能在补充品准备好取货时通知客户。 这些不准确之处引起了客户对隐私的担忧。

他们说，他们对人工智能越来越不满，导致一些顾客完全离开药房，并迫使其他人继续使用他们不信任的系统，因为农村地区缺乏药品选择。

随着人工智能在全国各地医疗保健系统中的出现，几位律师告诉 VTDigger，该技术的发展速度超出了监管范围，导致消费者保护薄弱。

美国公民自由联盟高级专职律师科迪·文茨克 (Cody Venzke) 表示：“法律的出台有所延迟，因此我们还没有看到公司将如何遵守或各州将如何执行法律的详细情况。”

在佛蒙特州，州长签署了一项新的数据隐私法案 S.71。 Phil Scott于6月16日生效，两年后生效。 这种延迟造成了法案遵守方面的差距，隐私倡导者称该法案已经太弱，无法保护消费者。

“即使它生效，我也不确定它是否一定能涵盖这种情况，”在该法案上作证的佛蒙特州律师兼居民瑞安·克里格(Ryan Kriger)说。

“没有价值，就没有好处”

Kinney Drugs 于 5 月份实施了人工智能虚拟助手，用于患者沟通和续药服务。 他们说，不久之后，其客户开始遇到问题。

“我的第一印象是，它比以前的录音和服务更复杂、更麻烦，”马特·彭尼 (Matt Penney) 说，他在佛蒙特州的金尼药房 (Kinney Drugs) 接受药物治疗已有两年左右。

以前，要在 Kinney Drugs 重新配药，顾客需要拨打基于提示的按键式电话系统，这样他们就可以通过键盘联系药剂师。 与 VTDigger 交谈的客户表示，这个旧系统运行顺利，没有出现任何问题。

他们说，新系统的情况就不一样了。

“这只是浪费时间并延迟客户服务的事情。 就我而言，它绝对没有价值，对客户没有任何好处，”Vermont Kinney Drugs 客户 Dave Bellini 说。

该人工智能助手由第三方人工智能制药公司 Synerio 打造，Kinney Drugs 以创始人的名字命名为 Burt。 在药房条款中，Kinney Drugs 指出“Burt 可能不准确、不完整或不最新，并且可能具有误导性或包含错误和遗漏。”

任何向 Kinney Drugs 提供电话号码的顾客都会自动同意与该工具进行交互，尽管根据药房的条款，他们稍后可能会选择退出。 虽然一些客户回忆起今年夏天早些时候签署了新的补充系统，但其他人表示，直到他们要求补充并听到人工智能声音时，他们才意识到该公司实施了新工具。

“伯特要求你和他谈谈，”佛蒙特州金尼药业 (Vermont Kinney Drugs) 客户、曾在医疗保健领域担任麻醉师的玛丽亚·阿文尼 (Maria Aveni) 说。 “没有选择使用键盘来输入你想要的内容，这就是我进行过的其他电话交互的情况。 所以这更像是和伯特谈谈，否则就别去拿药。”

据 Aveni 和其他接受 VTDigger 采访的客户称，Kinney Drugs 在实施之前并未就该工具进行沟通。

本月，当艾维尼（Aveni）延迟收到医生开出的药物时，她感到很庆幸这不是救命药。 尽管如此，她还是感到惊慌。 她说，从那以后，她只亲自去药房配药，以避免人工智能互动。

但对于生活在农村地区、交通条件有限的其他人来说，亲自去领取补充品来绕过人工智能是不可能的。

一位不愿透露姓名的 Kinney Drugs 代表在给 VTDigger 的一份声明中写道，该公司“意识到一些患者对 Burt 感到沮丧，特别是在推出期间”，并且正在审查每个问题并试图接触到每个患者。

虽然客户表示他们对 Kinney Drugs 为何转向人工智能感到困惑，但该公司给出了一个明确的原因：消除重复性任务并为药剂师腾出时间。

该公司的领导者相信人工智能有助于实现这一目标，一位董事表示“它确实起到了作用，并且以如此好的方式处理这些电话，从而减少了打给我们药房的电话。”

但客户对该工具的体验往往会带来相反的效果。 当他们遇到人工智能问题时，许多人更多地向药剂师寻求帮助。 在佛蒙特州，由于长期劳动力短缺，药剂师已经不堪重负。

“这降低了本已压力重重的员工的生产力，而且由于该员工长期以来一直对待我，而且我感到忠诚，这对我来说不仅仅是一个财务问题，而且是一种不人道的对待员工的方式，”艾维尼说。

“隐私即将被抛之脑后”

虽然人工智能工具报告的不准确性是许多客户的主要挫败感，但其他人则以隐私问题为由离开了连锁店。

“当我走进商店并真正阅读隐私政策时，我感到震惊，并立即将我的处方转移到 UVM 医院，”佛蒙特州 Kinney Drugs 前客户 Tuan Green 说。

例如，与人工智能助手同月发布的药房隐私政策披露，客户受保护的健康信息可能会在人工智能工具中使用，以改善药房的运营。

佛蒙特金尼药业 (Vermont Kinney Drugs) 的客户史蒂芬·麦克阿瑟 (Stephen McArthur) 表示：“如今，隐私已经被抛之脑后了。”

除了 Kinney Drugs 之外，客户和隐私专家也对 Synerio 表示担忧，Synerio 是一家总部位于德克萨斯州的科技公司，为该药房提供人工智能工具。

佛蒙特大学计算机科学副教授约瑟夫·尼尔表示，从隐私角度来看，人工智能工具比药房之前的续药系统更糟糕，因为这家名为 Synerio 的新公司现在也可以访问顾客的健康数据。

“如果我只是与我的医疗保健提供者互动，我就会依赖他们所提供的安全保障。 如果他们现在开始与许多其他组织进行互动，我现在就必须开始担心他们每个组织的所有安全问题。”范德比尔特大学医学中心生物医学信息学教授 Bradley Malin 在谈到 Synerio 时说道。

Kinney Drugs 代表表示，该公司维持“多层安全控制”，投资“信息安全技术以帮助保护敏感数据”，并制定协议来应对潜在的数据泄露。

几位律师和数据隐私专家表示，医疗保健环境中的人工智能还引起了围绕联邦健康隐私法 HIPAA 的一系列担忧，并指出受保护的健康信息可能存在数据共享。

然而，只要药房签订了业务合作协议（HIPAA 下的合同，规定第三方供应商安全地处理受保护的健康信息），公司就有合同义务安全地处理数据。 Kinney Drugs 代表拒绝透露该协议，理由是无法披露私人供应商合同，但写道该公司“维持适当的协议”。

Synerio 没有回应多次置评请求，但也在其网页上表示，其创建的工具是为了符合 HIPAA 的要求而构建的。

虽然 Synerio 没有回应 VTDigger 关于客户保护的问题，但 Kinney Drugs 的药房管理系统 McKesson 在公开文件中承认了这些问题，并写道“对第三方人工智能工具和解决方案的依赖可能会让我们面临超出我们控制范围的风险，包括合规漏洞。”

“同意并不是一个现实的解决方案”

随着各州开始制定旨在保护数据隐私的法律，新兴的人工智能工具（例如 Kinney Drug 实施的工具）可以作为这些法律有效性的测试案例。

佛蒙特州公共利益研究小组的隐私倡导者扎克·托马内利 (Zach Tomanelli) 表示，客户对人工智能的体验就是佛蒙特州数据隐私法案应该走得更远的一个例子。 该法律赋予居民权利，了解他们的哪些信息正在被收集、纠正不准确的数据以及选择不出售他们的数据。 但律师和倡导者表示，它为收集数据的公司提供了太多的豁免。

UVM 计算机科学教授尼尔表示，像佛蒙特州新法律这样的法规本质上是有缺陷的，因为它们是基于消费者同意的。 例如，Kinney Drugs 将其条款和条件分散在 11 个文件中。

他说：“我认为人们绝对不明白他们同意什么，因此，将我们的监管和我们认为可以接受的内容建立在同意的基础上，并不是解决当今此类隐私问题的现实解决方案。”

俄克拉荷马大学 HIPAA 教授史黛西·托维诺 (Stacey Tovino) 表示，隐私法允许患者请求纠正不准确的健康信息。 但这个过程非常繁琐，托维诺本人表示，她只会换药店以避免接触。

然而，佛蒙特州农村地区的客户可能没有一个方便的选择可以转用，甚至那些转用的人也说他们不想这样做，理由是他们与小型药房连锁店和那里的工作人员建立了个人联系。

“我不想离开我真的很喜欢、可以步行去的药房，”艾维尼说。 “但如果事情不能自行解决，我会的。”

披露：Kinney Drugs 是 VTDigger 的广告商。
